## REQ-LOC-001

**Field of the Locale DataSet**

The Payload of a Locale DataSetMessage contains the field Locale, a String with an OPC UA LocaleId (e.g. "en-US", "de-DE"); no other field. The field is present although its Requirement is Optional, as it is the only content of the DataSet (proposal SF-062 (d)).

- Keyword: MUST
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester
- Condition: The NetworkMessage carries a Locale.
- Scope: MG 8.2.7
- Refs: MG 8.3.12, SF-062
- Verification: schema, d7-validate
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-8.3.12-e0f896b3

## REQ-LOC-002

**A Get with Locale is answered in the requested language**

A Get may carry a Locale. If the responder supports localization and the requested locale, it publishes all LocalizedText elements of the answer (with the ReplyTo of the Get) in the requested locale, otherwise in its default locale English (proposal SF-062 (e)). A Locale in another method is ignored by the receiver (proposal SF-062 (c)).

- Keyword: MUST (implicit, SF-035)
- Levels: L1 MUST · L2 MUST · L3 MUST
- Domain: messaging · Applies to: requester, responder
- Condition: The Get carries a Locale.
- Scope: MG 8.2.7
- Refs: MG 8.3.12, SF-035, SF-062
- Verification: d7-test
- Status: draft
- Inventory: MG-8.3.12-2d12b693, MG-8.3.12-f857d6fc

> The DataSetMessage with Locale information can be added to all methods but its obvious meaning is related to Get.
> — MG 8.3.12

> The information is provided via the method Get and can be combined with any Resource, which might have LocalizedText elements in it.
> — MG 8.3.12

Notes: Keyword-less "will provide all LocalizedText elements in the requested language" (MG 8.3.12) read as MUST for a supported locale; the Get sentence names a "Local payload" (SF-062 (f)).
